title: Level Editor Capstone
goal: Build YOUR level. Save it. Play it.
mascot_lines: A level editor is a tool that lets you build levels by clicking instead of typing.
You drag tiles where you want them, then save and play.
Editors are amazing because they let you try ideas in seconds.
Game makers use them to test new levels really fast — so can you!

tier2.rephrase: Order the steps to make a good level.

tier3.nudge: Floor first. Then coins to grab. Then a challenge. Then a flag at the end!
